This is the original printed text (version 1 of 3). The current text is [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Remastered)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee alternate-image card image<ref name="eh1351-greenalt-0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021).</ref>. First published 19 February 2021. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of any starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (PC Errata)]]): Players Committee alternate-image card image<ref name="eh1351-greenalt-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022).</ref>. First published 15 January 2022. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “one”; the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Remastered)]]): Players Committee alternate-image card image<ref name="eh1351-greenalt-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022).</ref>. First published 12 December 2022. The Players Committee alternate-image catalog of December 2022 shows the same face. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'” '''What changed:''' the words are the same. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
